scope: Whole actual ClientFlow orchestration plus actual typed quarantine domain with native source, checkpoint, owner hold, transport and response-token adapters. Reflection only removes schedule delay. Covers original identity retention, stale grant renewal without replacement/early effects, terminal requery, own saved ACK digest requery, final release, unknown-prefix hold, loaded phase2 same-original settle without replan, invalid loaded source, historical metadata release, phase3 ACK refusal/resumption, whole-flow original evidence, foreign-world refusal, detach/rollback and changed actual feedback reference refusal. Does not certify native permission capture, file persistence, full owner lifecycle group or actual reconnect.
